serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Bidscale helps federal acquisition professionals move faster across three  
high-burden workflows: Requirements Development, Acquisition Package, and 
Offer Evaluation. AI modules guide inputs, support contract data, generate stronger 
drafts, and organize evaluation records so teams can produce clear, consistent,  
and defensible outputs.

AI-Supported Acquisition Workflows
1. Requirements Development:  Guide program teams through requirements inputs, predict key contract data, and generate stronger first drafts. 
2. Acquisition Package: Support strategy decisions, assemble required materials, and create acquisition documents with configurable workflows. 
3. Offer Evaluation: Review proposals digitally, develop findings, and generate evaluation reports with a clear audit trail.
